Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring agreements for power generation projects or facilities operated by public utility districts in distressed counties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to power generation projects or facilities operatedby public utility districts in distressed counties; and adding a newsection to chapter 54.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 54.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When a public utility district constructs or operates ahydroelectric project or power generation facility on the Columbiariver, and the facility is located in a distressed county as defined inRCW 43.160.220 with less than twentyfive percent of its land masssubject to local property taxes, the public utility district shallnegotiate an agreement with the county in which the project or facilityis located. The purpose of the agreement is for the county and thepublic utility district to share in the reasonable benefits derivedfrom the facility. (2) Within one hundred twenty days of the effective date of thissection, the county and the public utility district must reach areasonable agreement. If an agreement cannot be reached, then theissue must be submitted to arbitration pursuant to chapter 7.04A RCW. p. 1 HB 3196The county, the public utility district, and the governor shallparticipate in the arbitration proceeding. The arbitrator orarbitrator panel must reach a final decision within sixty days.
